title: Fixed Stepped Loop Escalator Module
description: One original complete fixed escalator-module appearance: one continuous thick stepped annular flight with real open interior and lower return, separate stationary low/high landing plates with mounting flanges, two full opaque sloped balustrades, and two separate closed thick handrail return loops with end-entry housings. Unlike a flat running belt or a rigid stair cart, the stepped top and both terminal returns belong to one material loop, while handrails form their own continuous loops alongside two different-level landings. No old meshes imported. Three opaque PBR materials, metres and actual XY-envelope centring. One uninstalled static module, no building floors, passenger or motor/drive internals; lowest return edge is export datum, not a certified ground sole. No animation, physical chain articulation, step synchronisation, handrail movement, comb clearance, human accessibility, capacity, loading, installation or safety performance claim.
